deep_dive.summary: karpathy/autoresearch is gaining traction with 40,204 stars. AI agents running research on single-GPU nanochat training automatically. This represents a significant trend in Python tooling for production systems. FDEs should understand whether this is a flash-in-the-pan or a genuine shift in how teams build AI systems.
deep_dive.fde_takeaway: Evaluate karpathy/autoresearch for client relevance. If it solves a real problem, early expertise = premium positioning. If not, you save clients from chasing hype.
